abntex2.comments: Extension of the incompatible memoir class.

amsart.comments: Currently `\maketitle` and `\@starttoc` will need adjustment. Used by project example arxiv3.

amsldoc.comments: See some needed adjustments in project example `amsldoc`.

beamer.comments: Internals rebox material repeatedly in a way that is not compatible with any form of tagging support. The ltx-talk class is being developed as an alternative, and is recommended for new tagged presentations.

extarticle.comments: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use article + extsizes.

extbook.comments: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use book + extsizes.

extletter.comments: Tagging is not ideal. See letter class.

extproc.comments: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use proc + extsizes.

extreport.comments: Missing patches for `\maketitle` and TOCs. For now use report + extsizes.

ltugboat.comments: `\bull` needs proper Unicode mapping. Optional argument to verbatim leads to errors

ltx-talk.comments: A new class developed from scratch for tagging; intended as a substitute for the popular beamer class for presentations

memoir.comments: Some code showing the needed adjustments can be found in the [bible example](https://github.com/latex3/tagging-project/blob/main/project-examples/ASV/bible.tex).

minimal.comments: The minimal class is not useful even for MWE's. Don't use it.

novel.comments: Would need to use use pdfmanagement for XMP metadata and not error when array is loaded, among other fixes.

oblivoir.comments: Extension of the incompatible memoir class.

revtex4-1.comments: Obsolete class: new documents should use 4-2.

simplecv.comments: Tagging of title and headers is not ideal.

standalone.comments: With the standalone class, content is lost at pdf level due to being boxed. Using the standalone package to input standlone files is compatible.

MnSymbol.comments: `\circledR` and `\circledS` need ToUnicode values. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

a4.comments: Obsolete. Use the `a4paper` class option or the geometry package.

a4wide.comments: Obsolete. Use the geometry package instead.

aboensis.comments: Text not correctly mapped to unicode.

academicons.comments: Symbols need ToUnicode values or Alt text.

accents.comments: amsmath must be loaded before accents. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

achemso.comments: Note the achemso class is not compatible, only the package.

acronym.comments: List of acronyms is tagged as list rather than TOC and dotfill should be tagged as artifact.

adfarrows.comments: The fonts must be loaded via the package for correct ToUnicode values.

adfbullets.comments: The fonts must be loaded via the package for correct ToUnicode values.

adforn.comments: The fonts must be loaded via the package for correct ToUnicode values.

adjustbox.comments: `varwidth` and `stack` keys rely on currently-incompatible varwidth package. Does not register `alt`, `artifact`, or `actualtext` keys for `\adjincludegraphics`. `\adjustbox` creates empty tags.

adobeornaments.comments: Symbols missing ActualText or ToUnicode values. Package not in texlive.

ae.comments: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

aecompl.comments: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

aeguill.comments: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

afterpackage.comments: Obsolete. Use the package hooks provided by the kernel.

algorithm.comments: `algorithm` environments not tagged as floats. See float package.

alnumsec.comments: Should not use mathematical Greek letters in section numbers.

amsbsy.comments: pmb produces extra tags from typesetting argument three times

amscd.comments: Breaks with unicode-math. No luamml support.

amsfonts.comments: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

amsmidx.comments: Meant for use with amsbook which is currently incompatible.

amssymb.comments: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

amsxtra.comments: `\accentedsymbol` not supported by luamml and errors with mathml-SE.

anysize.comments: Obsolete. Use the typearea or geometry packages.

appendixnumberbeamer.comments: beamer is not a supported class.

arabi.comments: Obsolete. Use luatex with arabluatex or babel; see the babel [guide](https://latex3.github.io/babel/guides/locale-arabic.html).

arabtex.comments: Use lualatex and babel with OpenType fonts instead.

aramaic.comments: Aramaic text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

arrayjob.comments: Obsolete. Use the arrayjobx package instead.

atableau.comments: No way to add alt text to tableau used outside a `tikzpicture`.

atbegshi.comments: Obsolete. Use the shipout hooks provided by the kernel.

atveryend.comments: This is an obsolete package. The hooks it defines are available directly from the LaTeX kernel when using the `\AddToHook` interface.

aurical.comments: Some characters with `\Fontamici` are not correctly mapped to Unicode.

autoaligne.comments: Tags each character as a separate formula. No luamml support.

autobreak.comments: Does not error but the package functionality is disabled with tagging.

axessibility.comments: Loads tagpdf but it is not compatible with the current version. Its patches clash with the math module.

axodraw2.comments: `axopicture` environment can take same optional argument as `picture` to set `alt`, `artifact`, etc.

babel.comments: Most likely compatible for many languages, but this needs tests for each language, so listed as unknown for now. For individual languages and dialects see the entries babel-xxx [in the full list](full#babel).

bbm.comments: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

bbold.comments: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

bboldx.comments: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

beamerposter.comments: beamer is not a supported class.

bearwear.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

bezier.comments: Empty compatibility package, can be removed from the preamble

bibunits.comments: No links with hyperref. No Reference structure for links.

bicaption.comments: Relies on currently incompatible caption package.

bidi.comments: Requires xetex so tests are excluded.

bigdelim.comments: Relies on incompatible multirow. No luamml support in math mode.

bm.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

booktabs.comments: Requires the firstaid module which contains a fix.

boxedminipage.comments: drawn box is tagged as Path instead of artifact

breakurl.comments: Requires latex->dvips->ps2pdf. For this reason, tests are excluded.

breqn.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

bussproofs.comments: Tagged as normal text instead of figure with Alt text.

cancel.comments: No luamml support. Text mode commands are tagged incorrectly.

caption.comments: the configurations from the package are overwritten by the tagging code. Issue when hyperref and both listoffigures are used.

caption2.comments: Obsolete. Use the caption package instead.

causets.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text is given to `\pcauset`, etc.

cellspace.comments: Package is broken with p-type columns with current LaTeX. --- Fixed in 2026

chemfig.comments: Figures are tagged as a sequence of many formulas. Errors with lua-unicode-math.

chronosys.comments: `chronology` environment does not produce a Figure.

circledsteps.comments: Missing TextDecoration attributes. No luamml support in math mode.

cmll.comments: No luamml support. Must be loaded before lua-unicode-math.

collectbox.comments: Limited by current tagging of boxes.

colortbl.comments: Breaks tagging if tables are nested. #90 issue with longtable fixed at the last release. #749 fixed in newest colortbl version.

concrete.comments: Simply loads the beton and euler packages. The latter is incompatible with unicode-math.

continue.comments: Continuation marks should be tagged as Artifacts.

contour.comments: Typesets the content many times which produces incorrect tags.

cookingsymbols.comments: Missing ActualText or ToUnicode values for symbols.

cprotect.comments: Breaks TOC and errors in math mode.

csquotes.comments: Extra space after opening quote with luatex.

csvsimple.comments: `\csvautotabularray` etc. are not supported since tabularray is currently incompatible.

ctex.comments: Option `heading=true` breaks section heading tagging. Same problem with classes ctexart, ctexbook, and ctexrep. Breaks math environments.

cypriot.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

dashrule.comments: `\hdashrule` commands should be tagged as Artifacts.

dcolumn.comments: `d` columns are set as text not math, which is arguably correct, but needs some further evaluation.

dcpic.comments: No way to add Alt text to diagram; see pictex.

derivative.comments: luamml support of `\odif` etc. is not ideal.

doclicense.comments: Graphics need Alt text. Metadata is set with hyperxmp which tagging code disables.

domaincoloring.comments: Alt text must be specified in the `grfOptions` key of `\DomainColoring`.

dotlessj.comments: Symbols not correctly mapped to unicode.

dpfloat.comments: Package is not compatible with the current LaTeX output routine.

dsfont.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

dsserif.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

dutchcal.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

dynkin-diagrams.comments: No way to pass Alt text to `\dynkin` or a `dynkinDiagram` outside of a `tikzpicture`.

ebgaramond-maths.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

ebproof.comments: Tagging and mathml of `prooftree` is not correct.

eepic.comments: Does not work with pdflatex or lualatex. Suggested replacement is the package bxeepic.

efbox.comments: No errors but there is no tagging information about the boxes.

embrac.comments: Inserts and removes unnecessary spaces at pdf level.

emo.comments: Symbols disappear in tags with lualatex. Inserts images that need actualtext or ToUnicode values with pdflatex.

emoji.comments: Compatible with some emoji fonts, however default Noto Color fonts are not supported at the PDF tagging level.

endnotes.comments: Does not error but `\endnote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

endnotesj.comments: Does not error but `\endnote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

enotez.comments: `\pagenote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s. `\ref` in `\endnotemark` produces parent-child warnings.

enumext.comments: Temporary issue with footnotes after lists.

enumitem.comments: The package itself can't be loaded right now. However, the tagging code supports (most of) the document-level syntax of `enumitem`, so that one can use, for example, `\begin{itemize}[...]` out of the box.

enverb.comments: Works with fancyvrb environments but not standard `verbatim`.

epigraph.comments: Requires a blank line after `\epigraph` command.

epsdice.comments: Missing Alt text for dice graphics.

epsf.comments: Obsolete. Images not tagged as Figure. No way to add Alt or ActualText.

eqnlines.comments: Works with minor deficiencies. Uses adaption of latex-lab-math.ltx internal macro `\math_register_halign_env:nn` to grab math contents. Adjustments towards final tagging interfaces likely necessary.

esint.comments: amsmath must be loaded before esint. Symbols overwritten by unicode-math.

eso-pic.comments: Content of `\AddToShipoutPictureBG` should always be Artifact.

esstixbb.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

esstixcal.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

esstixfrak.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

etruscan.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

eucal.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

eufrak.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

euler.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

eulervm.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

eurosym.comments: `\euro` not correctly mapped to Unicode symbol.

everypage.comments: Obsolete. Use the hooks provided by the kernel.

expl3.comments: Legacy package. Now built into the kernel.

exscale.comments: Currently errors with unicode-math and mathml-SE.

extpfeil.comments: Incomplete luamml support. Must be loaded before unicode-math.

extsizes.comments: Just defines sizes so should not cause any trouble.

faktor.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

fancyheadings.comments: Obsolete. Use the fancyhdr package instead.

fdsymbol.comments: `\circledR` and `\circledS` need ToUnicode values. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

filecontents.comments: Obsolete. The `filecontents` environment is now provided by the kernel.

filehook.comments: Obsolete. Use the file hooks provided by the kernel.

fitch.comments: Proper tagging requires the package is loaded with `[arrayenv=tabular]` and not used in math mode. Result is well-tagged but not yet accessible. See documentation.

fix2col.comments: Obsolete. Does nothing with a current LaTeX.

fixltx2e.comments: This is an obsolete package which should not be needed

fncychap.comments: Compatible when used with a -dev format or with a LaTeX release of 2026/11/01 or newer.

fonetika.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

fontawesome5.comments: Symbols missing ToUnicode or ActualText. Produces reasonable replacement text in ngPDF with luatex.

fontawesome6.comments: Symbols missing ToUnicode or ActualText. Produces reasonable replacement text in ngPDF with luatex.

fontawesome7.comments: Symbols missing ToUnicode or ActualText. Produces reasonable replacement text in ngPDF with luatex.

footnoterange.comments: Footnote label i-j incorrectly tagged as normal text. hyperref support is broken since it relies on the existence of an `Hfootnote` counter which tagging-version does not provide.

footnpag.comments: Footnote tagging is correct but breaks footnotes in `\maketitle`. Tests excluded as loops after error.

fourier.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

fouriernc.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

framed.comments: Title in `titled-frame` environment is lost. Content after page break is lost with pdftex and xetex.

frcursive.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

froufrou.comments: Ornaments should be tagged as Artifacts.

fwlw.comments: Words printed in header/footer should be tagged as Artifacts.

gelasiomath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

gensymb.comments: Errors if loaded after unicode-math. No luamml support.

gentium.comments: This package was removed from texlive.

german.comments: Obsolete. Use the `german` option of babel.

ghsystem.comments: Uses math where it doesn't need to. `\ghspic` should have Alt text by default.

glossaries.comments: An old issue appears to be fixed.

gmp.comments: No way to add Alt text or Artifact status to `mpost` figures used directly. This can be done with `\usempost`, however.

grabbox.comments: Boxes are not yet supported by the tagging code.

graphbox.comments: Inserts empty Div after every Figure.

graphicx.comments: Rather than `\includegraphics[whatever]{whatever}` one should now write `\includegraphics[whatever, alt={This is the alternative text.}]{whatever}` The alternative text will be ignored if tagging is not used. It seems that draft mode doesn’t work at present. An old issue with height appears to be fixed.

graphpap.comments: tagging passes validation but is sub-optimal

greek4cbc.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

greek6cbc.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

grmath.comments: amsmath must be loaded before grmath. Not compatible with luatex, hence no luamml support.

harvard.comments: No links with hyperref. No Reference structure for links.

here.comments: Obsolete. Just loads the float package.

hieroglf.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

hypcap.comments: The tagging code already moves anchors to the top of floats so this package is unnecessary. package updated

hyperref.comments: Forms not supported; use l3pdffield-testphase for forms.

hyperxmp.comments: Incompatible with PDF management, loading is suppressed. XMP-metadata are handled by the kernel code.

incgraph.comments: `alt`, `artifact`, and `actualtext` keys can be used in second optional argument of `\incgraph`, `\incmultigraph`, and `\incmultipages`.

indxcite.comments: See harvard and index packages. Not distributed with texlive.

inputenc.comments: Should not be needed with new documents.

inputenx.comments: Should not be needed with new documents.

isotope.comments: Tagging of isotopes in text mode is not ideal.

iwonamath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

jigsaw.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

karnaugh-map.comments: No way to add Alt text to the diagrams. Some examples error with pdftex.

keytheorems.comments: tcolorbox theorems disabled when tagging is loaded. `headformat` key not fully implemented with tagging. `auto-qed` not fully compatible with tagging.

kpfonts.comments: Loads kpfonts-otf with unicode engine, required for producing mathml.

l3draw.comments: Not meant for document-level use. See hawkdraw for a compatible user interface to l3draw.

l3keys2e.comments: Obsolete. Use the option handling commands provided by the kernel.

latexrelease.comments: Rolling the LaTeX format too far back will result in the loss of necessary support code for tagging, rolling forward should work.

layouts.comments: Drawn frames should be Artifacts. Pictures need Alt text.

letltxmacro.comments: Superseded by `\NewCommandCopy` etc. provided by the kernel.

lettrine.comments: Provides `actualtext` key for use with `image` key.

libertinust1math.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

liftarm.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

lilyglyphs.comments: Symbols missing Alt text or Unicode mappings.

linearb.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

lineno.comments: Loses line numbers and line numbers are not tagged correctly. See lualineno for a compatible alternative.

longtable.comments: A longtable with page breaks works with pdftex only if at least latex-dev from February 2025 is used.

longtwocolumn.comments: Fully compatible with lualatex. Content lost with pdflatex.

luadraw.comments: One of the TikZ keys `alt`, `actualtext`, or `artifact` must be given in `pictureoptions`

luainputenc.comments: Should not be needed with new documents.

lualineno.comments: Content with tagged structure in line numbers must have tagging suspended. Regular line numbers are automatically tagged as artifacts.

luamesh.comments: Missing way to add Alt text to underlying mplibcode or tikz environments.

luamml.comments: Should not need to be loaded directly. Loaded with `tagging=on` when luatex is detected.

luamplib.comments: Offers several keys for figures including `alt` and `artifact`.

luatexbase.comments: Legacy package. Functionality built into the kernel.

luatexja.comments: Some extension packages may not be compatible, e.g. luatexja-ruby.

luatexko.comments: Package provides tagging support for `\ruby`, `\dotemph`, `\uline`, and other underline-type commands.

lucidabr.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support. Use lucida-otf with lualatex for full compatibility.

makecell.comments: Interaction with incompatible multirow package not yet supported. `\diaghead` command uses `picture` environment that is tagged as a figure.

mathabx.comments: Must be loaded after amsmath. Math symbols are not sensibly mapped to unicode. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathalpha.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathastext.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathdesign.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathpazo.comments: A pdftex engine bug has been fixed. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathpple.comments: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `mathpazo`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathptm.comments: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newtxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathptmx.comments: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newtxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mathstone.comments: No luamml support. Incompatible with unicode-math.

mathtime.comments: No luamml support. Incompatible with unicode-math.

mathtools.comments: `mathic` key produces errors. `centercolon` incompatible with unicode-math. luamml support is limited to `multlined` and `\shortintertext`.

mattens.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

mdsymbol.comments: `\circledR` and `\circledS` need ToUnicode values. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

memoize-ext.comments: Adds sockets to the utilisation of externs created by Memoize. actualtext/alt/artifact supported for TikZ pictures.

menukeys.comments: None of the formatting is represented at the tag level; spaces between keywords are lost.

metsymb.comments: Symbols missing ToUnicode or Alt text.

midfloat.comments: No longer included in texlive, so tests excluded

minted.comments: Listings not tagged properly. See fvextra and fancyvrb.

movie15.comments: Obsolete. Use the media9 package instead.

multilang.comments: Argument structure is not recognised once tagging enabled

multind.comments: Does not use section command for index headings. Not distributed with texlive.

nabatean.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

nameref.comments: Fully compatible except for theorem notes and description labels.

nath.comments: Incompatibly redefines nearly all math commands.

ncccropbox.comments: Crop marks are tagged as Path.

newproof.comments: Errors with 2026 format. Implements proofs as lists so tagging is not ideal.

newpxmath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

newtxmath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

newtxsf.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

newunicodechar.comments: Needs a way to support ActualText for characters.

ngerman.comments: Obsolete. Use the `ngerman` option of babel.

nicefrac.comments: Text-mode fractions are implemented as a sequence of formulas.

nicematrix.comments: Simple text-mode tabulars are tagged reasonably well. No luamml support.

nidanfloat.comments: Package is broken with current LaTeX independent of tagging.

notomath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

numprint.comments: In text mode, printed numbers are a mix of text and math.

oands.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

old-arrows.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

oldprsn.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

oubraces.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

overcite.comments: Just loads cite package with the `superscript` option.

overpic.comments: No way to tag as Artifact or with Alt text. Argument of `Overpic` cannot contain arbitrary content like tabular.

pagecolor.comments: Interaction with crop package not supported until crop is made compatible.

pagenote.comments: Does not error but `\pagenote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

parnotes.comments: Does not error but `\parnote`s are not tagged as `<Note>`s.

pdfoverlay.comments: pdf added to shipout/background so corresponding tag appears at end of page

pdfpages.comments: Creates duplicated structures as graphics are processed more than once in trial typesetting. Correct tagging of multipage includes unclear.

pdfrender.comments: Only works with luatex and pdftex.

pdfx.comments: Incompatible with PDF-management, loading is suppressed. Standards should be set with `\DocumentMetadata` keys.

pgf-pie.comments: Compatible if `alt` text given to containing `tikzpicture`.

pgf-spectra.comments: No way to add Alt text to spectra; poor tagging for `\pgfspectratable`.

pgf-umlcd.comments: Compatible if `alt` text given to containing `tikzpicture`.

pgfgantt.comments: Compatible if used within a `tikzpicture` given `alt` text. No way to pass `alt` directly to a `ganttchart` environment.

pgfornament.comments: No way to add alt text to a `\pgfornament`.

pgfplots.comments: Compatibility depends on tikz but also needs its own adjustments.

pgfplotstable.comments: Table tagging is correct but any interaction with pgfplots is not yet supported.

pgfrcs.comments: Relies on patches in pdfmanagement to make pgfrcs resource management compatible.

phoenician.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

pifont.comments: The ToUnicode values are incorrect in tl2025 luatex, they are fixed in tl2026.

pigpen.comments: With pdftex, spaces are lost. Tagged as the input, not cipher, text.

pmboxdraw.comments: Symbols are not correctly mapped to Unicode.

poetry.comments: Tagging of each line and line number as its own `<Part>` is not ideal. `\titleauthorpoem` errors.

polyomino.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

progressbar.comments: No way to pass alt text to underlying tikzpicture.

prooftrees.comments: Depends on forest-ext. Note tableaux are syntactic not semantic. Tagging generated from content added to Alt on surrounding Figure.

protosem.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

pstricks.comments: Possible compatibility is only with lualatex; dvips cannot properly support PDF/UA. Offers `alt`, `actualtext`, `artifact`, and `correct-BBox` keys, however these seem not to work. Not tagged as figures.

pxfonts.comments: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newpxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

pxpic.comments: pixpic's should be tagged as figures with Alt text.

pyluatex.comments: Test file requires shell escape and is excluded.

pythontex.comments: Verbatim environments not tagged correctly. See fvextra.

rank-2-roots.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text is given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

rawfonts.comments: Should not be used in new documents.

realboxes.comments: Depends on partially-compatible collectbox. `\Parbox` produces parent-child warnings. Graphics and dashbox macros not tagged correctly.

remreset.comments: Obsolete. Functionality now in the kernel.

romanbar.comments: `\Romanbar` produces rules that should be tagged as Artifacts.

runic.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

sansmath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

sansmathaccent.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

sansmathfonts.comments: Symbols in math mode are not mapped correctly to unicode. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

sarabian.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

savetrees.comments: Redefines `\maketitle` and uses titlesec to redefine section commands.

schemata.comments: Schema are tagged as math but there is no luamml support.

sectionbreak.comments: Section break marks are tagged; should probably be Artifacts.

selinput.comments: Only works with pdftex. Should not be necessary in new documents.

setouterhbox.comments: Only works with lualatex when tagging is loaded.

sfmath.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

shapepar.comments: Test currently excluded as it loops with pdftex.

showkeys.comments: Rules drawn around labels display as Path in tags and the label in the margin is either not tagged at all (pdflatex) or as artifact (lualatex). Unproblematic for a draft, but not UA compatible.

shuffle.comments: No luamml support. `\shuffle` command overwritten by unicode-math.

snotez.comments: Sidenotes are missing `<Lbl>`s and `sidefigure`s and `sidetable`s are not tagged correctly.

soulutf8.comments: This package is obsolete. Use the soul package directly.

spalign.comments: No luamml support for `\spalignsys`. Otherwise appears compatible.

spark-otf.comments: Spark charts need to be tagged as figure with Alt text.

sparklines.comments: No way to add Alt text to the `sparkline` environment.

srcltx.comments: Not useful with pdflatex or lualatex.

starfont.comments: Symbols not correctly mapped to Unicode.

steinmetz.comments: Picture used to draw symbol should be Artifact. No luamml support.

stix.comments: Obsolete, see stix2. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

stix2.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

stmaryrd.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

storebox.comments: Depends on partially-compatible collectbox. Loses all spaces in tags. Requires luatex85 with lualatex.

subcaption.comments: Issue when both hyperref and listoffigures are used.

subeqn.comments: Incompatible with amsmath which is loaded by the tagging code.

subscript.comments: Obsolete. The `\textsubscript` command is now provided by the kernel.

svg.comments: Missing user interface to set alt text, actualtext, artifact.

symbats3.comments: Symbols missing ActualText or ToUnicode values. Tests excluded since font not included in texlive.

tabu.comments: In theory a nice package but it is **broken** and **not maintained**. It is not compatible with current LaTeX, let alone with the tagging extensions. Do not use it for anything, unless it gets a new maintainer that brings it up to speed.

tagging.comments: This package allows conditional typesetting, i.e., tagging here means that the LaTeX source has labeled regions that you can include or exclude.

tcolorbox.comments: Simple boxes are now tagged correctly. Not yet fully supported, but some suggestions in the listed issues

tex4ht.comments: Simple files with `\DocumentMetadata` error when run with `tex4ht`.

texosquery.comments: Tests currently excluded since they depend on OS.

textcase.comments: This package is obsolete. Use the kernel `\MakeUppercase` and `\MakeLowercase`.

textcomp.comments: Package no longer needed as definitions have been moved into the kernel

textcsc.comments: Works correctly with Harbuzz renderer but not with Node.

thmtools.comments: Numbering with sibling key is wrong.

tikz.comments: Tagging code defines `alt`, `actualtext`, and `artifact` keys when tikz is loaded.

tikz-3dplot.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikz-dependency.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `dependency` environment.

tikz-dimline.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikz-feynman.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to `\feynmandiagram or the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikz-network.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikz-timing.comments: `Use of `\timing` is compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`. Similarly for `tikztimingtable`. No way to pass Alt text to `\ exttiming` or the `T` column type of the `columntype` library.

tikz-truchet.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikzbricks.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikzducks.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikzfill.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikzlings.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`. See also tikzducks.

tikzpeople.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikzphysics.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tikzpingus.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tipa.comments: Symbols not correctly mapped to Unicode. Consider using tipauni instead.

titleref.comments: Incompatible with hyperref. Main functionality is broken with tagging code. Use nameref instead.

tkz-berge.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tkz-elements.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tkz-euclide.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

tkz-graph.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

trainmap.comments: No way to add Alt text to a `trainmap`.

transparent.comments: Transparency across page breaks only works with luatex and pdftex.

trimclip.comments: Depends on partially-compatible collectbox. `\clipbox` adds empty tags.

trivfloat.comments: Environments defined with `\trivfloat` not tagged as floats. See float package.

tweaklist.comments: Modifications of list environments are overwritten by the tagging code.

txfonts.comments: Obsolete package; suggested replacement `newtxmath`. Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

txfontsb.comments: Incompatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

ucs.comments: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents. Ignored entirely with Unicode engines.

ugarite.comments: Text not correctly mapped to Unicode.

unicodefonttable.comments: Headings are incorrectly marked as data cells.

units.comments: No luamml support. Depends on incompatible nicefrac.

upgreek.comments: Most commands overwritten by unicode-math. No luamml support.

uri.comments: Produces empty containers after links if hyperref loaded.

utf8.comments: Obsolete. Do not use in new documents.

varwidth.comments: Tagging structure looks ok, but the formatting is wrong when the tagging code is used.

vector.comments: Not distributed with texlive. No luamml support for `\uvec` and `\uuvec` with `wavy` package option.

venndiagram.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the `tikzoptions` key of the `venndiagram3sets` or `venndiagram2sets` environment.

verbatim.comments: verbatim environment from package overwritten by tagging code; content input with `\verbatiminput` is tagged as normal text, not Code.

verse.comments: `\flagverse` and line numbers not tagged ideally.

warpcol.comments: Tests excluded as loops (no error raised).

wasysym.comments: Missing ToUnicode for text symbols. amsmath must be loaded before wasysym.

wheelchart.comments: Compatible as long as `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

worldflags.comments: No way to add Alt text to a `\worldflag` command. Compatible if used as `\pic`s within a `tikzpicture` given Alt text.

wrapstuff.comments: Errors outright with pdftex. The `width` and `type` keys produce parent-child warnings, so `\caption` cannot be used in the `wrapstuff` environment.

xcite.comments: This package now simply loads xr.

xevlna.comments: Tests excluded as package requires xetex.

xfp.comments: Legacy package. Functionality built in to the kernel.

xhfill.comments: Drawn rules should be tagged as Artifacts.

xistercian.comments: Missing ToUnicode or ActualText for symbols.

xltabular.comments: An xltabular with page breaks works with pdftex only if at least latex from June 2025 is used.

xparse.comments: Legacy package. Functionality built in to the kernel.

xpinyin.comments: Missing correct Ruby annotation. Only works with pdftex and xetex.

xr-hyper.comments: Package now identical to xr, thus not necessary any longer when hyperref is used.

xtemplate.comments: Legacy package. Templates are now supported in the kernel.

xy.comments: In text mode, no tagging occurs for `\xymatrix`. No luamml support. Requires luatex85 with luatex. unicode-math must be loaded after xy.

yhmath.comments: Not compatible with unicode-math. No luamml support.

youngtab.comments: No luamml support. Diagrams in text mode need Alt text and for rules to be tagged as Artifacts.

yquant.comments: Compatible if `alt` text given to the containing `tikzpicture`.

zhnumber.comments: Tests excluded because the results are font-dependent.

zref.comments: Most of the zref-* packages are compatible. Some still need to be checked.
